Title: The public preview of Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server now supported in new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server (public preview) deployment option is now available in the France Central and Brazil South regions. With Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server you can enjoy a simplified provisioning experience with:

  • Low total cost of ownership (TCO) with burstable SKU
  •  Stop/start
  • Better resiliency with zone redundant high availability
  • Better control with scheduled maintenance
  • Enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption
  • The openness of the community version of the Postgres database

Review the documentation and read the QuickStart information to learn more about this announcement. Visit the Azure Database for PostgreSQL products available by region page to learn more about regional availability.
